text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Environmental Protection and Management (Fees for Licences) Regulations.

2. The fees set out in the second column of the Schedule in respect of the matters set out in the first column thereof shall be payable to the Agency.
[S 552/2010 wef 01/10/2010]

THE SCHEDULE
Regulation 2
Fees
First column
Second column
1.For the grant or renewal of a licence to import or sell hazardous substances
(a)$200 for a licence granted or renewed for a period of 3 months
(b)$700 for a licence granted or renewed for a period of 5 years
2.For an application to amend a licence (that is granted or renewed for a period of 5 years) to import or sell hazardous substances
$280 per application, regardless of the number of amendments applied for
[S 672/2025 wef 01/01/2026]
[G.N. S 158/99; S 129/2000; S 711/2006]
